title: Construction of lanthanide single-molecule magnets with the “magnetic motif” [Dy(MQ)4]−

synthesis.procedure: A 10 mL ethanol solution of HMQ (64 mg, 0.400 mmol) and triethylamine (15 mg, 0.150 mmol) was stirred for 5 min in a 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (46 mg, 0.100 mmol) was added. The mixture was placed in an ultrasonic bath for 10 min, sealed, and reacted solvothermally at 343 K for 48 h. It was cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1, yielding yellow block-shaped crystals.
synthesis.temperature: 343 K; cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1
synthesis.time: 5 min stirring; 10 min ultrasonication; 48 h solvothermal reaction
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor; ultrasonication followed by sealed solvothermal reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1; yellow block-shaped crystals obtained.

properties.summary: The dinuclear complex shows weak ferromagnetic interactions and magnetic anisotropy, but no observable single-molecule-magnet behavior; no out-of-phase AC susceptibility peaks were observed with or without an applied DC field.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete Dy2 unit contains four MQ ligands and three nitrate anions, with a protonated triethylamine counterion and ethanol and water of crystallization. Three MQ ligands bridge the Dy centers. Dy1 has an N4O4 environment from the MQ ligands, while Dy2 has a DyO9 environment formed by three bridging MQ oxygen atoms and three chelating nitrates.

synthesis.procedure: A 10 mL ethanol solution of HMQ (64 mg, 0.400 mmol) and triethylamine (40 mg, 0.400 mmol) was stirred for 5 min in a 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (31 mg, 0.067 mmol) was added. The mixture was placed in an ultrasonic bath for 20 min, sealed, and reacted solvothermally at 343 K for 48 h. It was cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1, yielding yellow block-shaped crystals.
synthesis.temperature: 343 K; cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1
synthesis.time: 5 min stirring; 20 min ultrasonication; 48 h solvothermal reaction
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor; ultrasonication followed by sealed solvothermal reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature at 5 K h−1; yellow block-shaped crystals obtained.

properties.summary: The trinuclear complex exhibits single-molecule-magnet behavior. Under an 800 Oe DC field, distinct slow and fast relaxation processes appear at low temperature. The reported relaxation barrier depends on the fitting model and temperature regime.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete trinuclear Dy unit has two terminal Dy centers in N4O4 MQ coordination environments and a central Dy center in a DyO8 environment. Relative to compound 1, bridging MQ ligands occupy sites associated with two chelating nitrates, leaving one nitrate chelated to the central Dy. The article describes the resulting arrangement as two terminal [Dy(MQ)4] magnetic motifs connected through the central Dy-containing unit.
